   <title>Turkey: Steel plant explosion kills 17 in Izmir province</title>

   <guid>https://www.euronews.com/video/2026/11/09/turkey-steel-plant-explosion-kills-17-in-izmir-province</guid>
   <pubDate>Mon, 09 Nov 2026 23:02:16 +0100</pubDate>
   <description>A devastating explosion at the Habaş iron and steelworks in Aliağa, in western Turkey has killed 17 people. Witnesses described an earthquake-like blast, while footage shows flames, thick smoke and distressed relatives outside the factory.</description>

   <title>Poland: Tusk and Nawrocki honour six victims of Kraków shooting</title>

   <guid>https://www.euronews.com/video/2026/11/09/poland-tusk-and-nawrocki-honour-six-victims-of-krakow-shooting</guid>
   <pubDate>Mon, 09 Nov 2026 22:34:14 +0100</pubDate>
   <description>Poland's President and Prime Minister set aside their political differences to honour the six victims of a deadly shooting in Kraków. The two leaders laid candles and knelt together at a vigil in the historic city centre.</description>
  </item>
  <item>
   <title>Turkey: Delegates arrive in Antalya as COP31 climate talks begin</title>

   <guid>https://www.euronews.com/video/2026/11/09/turkey-delegates-arrive-in-antalya-as-cop31-climate-talks-begin</guid>
   <pubDate>Mon, 09 Nov 2026 22:23:15 +0100</pubDate>
   <description>The United Nations COP31 climate summit has opened in Antalya after a year marked by deadly heatwaves and devastating floods. Delegates face fresh challenges as the war in Iran disrupts global energy supplies.</description>
  </item>
  <item>
   <title>Polish president and PM join Krakow Silent March for victims of market shooting</title>

      <title>Collision of two trains in Egypt kills at least seven</title>
      <link>https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/08/egypt-two-trains-deadly-collision</link>
      <description><p>President orders prompt investigation after one train derails in collision in al-Ayyat about 50km from Cairo</p><p>Seven people were killed and at least 125 injured when two trains collided on Sunday south of the Egyptian capital, Cairo, officials said.</p><p>The crash occurred in al-Ayyat district in Giza province, about 50km (30 miles) south of Cairo, when a train travelling to Fayoum province crashed into the rear of a train heading to the southern province of Aswan, according to the transport ministry.</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/08/egypt-two-trains-deadly-collision">Continue reading...</a></description>

      <title>Kenyan doomsday sect leader jailed for 200 years for murder of 190 children</title>
      <link>https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/06/kenyan-doomsday-sect-leader-jailed-murders-paul-mackenzie</link>
      <description><p>Paul Mackenzie convicted over deaths of children and one adult after followers were ordered to starve themselves and their families</p><p>The leader of a Kenyan doomsday sect has been sentenced to 200 years in prison for the murders of 190 children and one adult in one of the world’s worst cult disasters in recent history.</p><p>The sentence, comprising 100 years for murder by starvation and 100 years by direct homicide, came two weeks after the court in Kenya’s coastal city of Mombasa <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/oct/19/kenya-starvation-cult-leader-guilty-murder-190-children">found the cult leader guilty</a> of the crimes.</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/06/kenyan-doomsday-sect-leader-jailed-murders-paul-mackenzie">Continue reading...</a></description>

      <title>ANC faces bruising defeat in South African local elections with 80% of ballots counted</title>
      <link>https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/06/anc-faces-defeat-south-african-local-elections</link>
      <description><p>Former liberation movement’s share of national vote almost 14 percentage points below 2021 result</p><p>The African National Congress is on course to suffer a bruising defeat in South Africa’s local elections, with the once dominant party of Nelson Mandela falling to under a third of the vote nationally with more than 80% of ballots counted.</p><p>Wednesday’s fragmented vote marks another stage in the decline of the ANC, which has led national governments since the end of white minority apartheid rule in 1994. High unemployment, crime, corruption and poor local service delivery have all contributed to <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/04/anc-south-africa-local-elections-water-outages-power-cuts">voters turning away from the party</a>.</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/06/anc-faces-defeat-south-african-local-elections">Continue reading...</a></description>

      <description><p>Patient is ⁠in ​stable condition and will be transferred to a specialist ‘high consequence’ infectious disease unit</p><p>A British healthcare worker with Ebola is being evacuated from the Democratic Republic of the Congo to the UK for medical treatment, it has been confirmed.</p><p>“A British citizen currently in the DR Congo has tested positive for Ebola,” a spokesperson for the UK government said in a statement on Wednesday. “The UK has well-established procedures for dealing with cases like this, and those processes have been activated … The risk to the UK public from Ebola remains low.”</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/04/british-healthcare-worker-ebola-evacuated-drc-to-uk-document-shows">Continue reading...</a></description>

<rss version="2.0" xmlns:atom="http://www.w3.org/2005/Atom" xmlns:media="http://search.yahoo.com/mrss/" xmlns:dc="http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/"><channel><language>en</language><title>France 24 - International breaking news, top stories and headlines</title><description>Breaking news and world news from France 24 on Business, Sports, Culture. News from the US, Europe, Asia Pacific, Africa, Middle East, America</description><link>https://www.france24.com/en/</link><lastBuildDate>Mon, 09 Nov 2026 21:49:29 GMT</lastBuildDate><atom:link href="https://www.france24.com/en/rss" rel="self" type="application/rss+xml"/><item><category>Europe</category><title>What to expect as Russia, Ukraine and the US hold trilateral talks in Abu Dhabi</title><link>https://www.france24.com/en/europe/20261109-what-to-expect-as-russia-ukraine-and-us-hold-trilateral-talks-in-abu-dhabi</link><description>
Negotiators from Ukraine, Russia and the United States are set to meet in the capital of the United Arab Emirates (UAE) on Tuesday for a new round of talks aimed at ending nearly five years of full-scale war triggered by Moscow's invasion of its neighbour. Security guarantees for the warring sides are set to top the agenda, with US officials insisting that a broader security architecture for Europe must be part of any peace deal.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/8e77aaca-dc82-11f1-9693-a575454bc579/w:1024/p:16x9/2026-11-05T090059Z-1254041086-RC26DNA29012-RTRMADP-3-UKRAINE-CRISIS-USA-RUSSIA.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/8e77aaca-dc82-11f1-9693-a575454bc579/w:1024/p:16x9/2026-11-05T090059Z-1254041086-RC26DNA29012-RTRMADP-3-UKRAINE-CRISIS-USA-RUSSIA.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">82ede6be-dc6f-11f1-b66f-c9c2e19e7715</guid><pubDate>Mon, 09 Nov 2026 21:46:23 GMT</pubDate><source url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/8e77aaca-dc82-11f1-9693-a575454bc579/w:1024/p:16x9/2026-11-05T090059Z-1254041086-RC26DNA29012-RTRMADP-3-UKRAINE-CRISIS-USA-RUSSIA.jpg">© Gavriil Grigorov, Reuters</source><dc:creator>FRANCE 24</dc:creator></item><item><category></category><title>French Judo superstar Teddy Riner says will run for president</title><link>https://www.france24.com/en/french-judo-superstar-teddy-riner-says-will-run-for-president</link><description>
France's multiple Olympic judo champion Teddy Riner announced on Monday he would run in next year's presidential election, after expressing concern about the "rise of the far right". "My name is Teddy Riner and today, I am telling you face to face: I am a candidate in the 2027 presidential election," the 37-year-old said in a surprise announcement on social media. Riner, one of the greatest judokas in history, said in the two-minute-37-second video that he feared France could soon become deeply divided, appearing to cast himself as a candidate for voters unwilling to choose between two political extremes -- the far right and the hard left. FRANCE 24's Mark Owen speaks with Yves Sintomer, Professor of Political Science at Université Paris VIII.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/f62a8bcc-dc7f-11f1-ad8f-d18c5759e759/w:1024/p:16x9/EN-20261109-213456-214006-CS.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/f62a8bcc-dc7f-11f1-ad8f-d18c5759e759/w:1024/p:16x9/EN-20261109-213456-214006-CS.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">fb2c97c8-dc7f-11f1-a762-f3f1ad594750</guid><pubDate>Mon, 09 Nov 2026 21:14:51 GMT</pubDate><dc:creator>FRANCE24</dc:creator></item><item><category>Truth or Fake</category><title>Trump says he was ‘kidding’ about Dana White press secretary job, amid online mix-up claims</title><link>https://www.france24.com/en/tv-shows/truth-or-fake/20261109-trump-says-he-was-kidding-about-dana-white-press-secretary-job-amid-online-mix-up-claims</link><description>
Donald Trump says he was "only kidding" when he announced he had offered his friend and UFC boss Dana White the job of White House press secretary. The president shared an AI-generated video of White behind the briefing room podium and UFC fighters attacking journalists. But the announcement also sparked online speculation that Trump may have confused the UFC executive with a former Pentagon spokesperson, also called Dana White. There's no evidence of a mix-up, as Vedika Bahl explains.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/46f18494-dc7f-11f1-80b4-a575454bc579/w:1024/p:16x9/dana-white.png"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/46f18494-dc7f-11f1-80b4-a575454bc579/w:1024/p:16x9/dana-white.png" type="image/png" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">5928d950-dc7f-11f1-8620-f5cafcaad1e3</guid><pubDate>Mon, 09 Nov 2026 20:51:32 GMT</pubDate><dc:creator>Vedika BAHL</dc:creator></item><item><category></category><title>Nvidia's Huang scandal rattles AI industry built around him</title><link>https://www.france24.com/en/nvidia-s-huang-scandal-rattles-ai-industry-built-around-him</link><description>
Nvidia chief Jensen Huang sits at the center of the artificial intelligence boom, and the spy scandal that erupted over the weekend threatens to shake the company at a time when confidence in the AI investment frenzy is already fragile. Taiwan-born Huang is regarded as the godfather of the AI economy, the executive every player in the industry must turn to because the technology depends on the graphics processing units (GPUs) that his company designs. FRANCE 24's Wassim Cornet reports from Los Angeles.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/b0c0757c-dc77-11f1-97b1-695cb59fade5/w:1024/p:16x9/EN-20261109-203701-204148-CS.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/b0c0757c-dc77-11f1-97b1-695cb59fade5/w:1024/p:16x9/EN-20261109-203701-204148-CS.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">b5a790ac-dc77-11f1-aa46-e978521f0d42</guid><pubDate>Mon, 09 Nov 2026 20:09:22 GMT</pubDate><dc:creator>FRANCE24</dc:creator></item><item><category></category><title>Paris prosecutor opens probe into IRGC cyber unit Shahid Kaveh over fridge cyberattacks</title><link>https://www.france24.com/en/paris-prosecutor-opens-probe-into-irgc-cyber-unit-shahid-kaveh-over-fridge-cyberattacks</link><description>
The Paris prosecutor said she had opened an investigation into Shahid Kaveh, a shadowy cyber unit of the IRGC, the Islamic republic's ideological army, over the 'unprecedented' cyberattacks targeting French supermarkets' fridges in October. Little is known about the Shahid Kaveh unit, although analysts have long observed that the IRGC, which has a vast network of operations, had actively branched out into cyber warfare in recent years. FRANCE 24's Reza Sayah reports from Tehran.

<![CDATA[ Latest from Space.com ]]> https://www.space.com/feeds.xml Mon, 09 Nov 2026 22:00:00 +0000 en <![CDATA[ Jupiter and Mars are set for a breathtaking close approach later this week: Here's how to see it ]]> Jupiter and Mars will shine side by side in a spectacular close approach in the heart of the constellation Leo on Nov. 15. Here's what you need to know.

Mars and Jupiter reach their closest apparent separation in Earth's sky at 9:04 p.m. EST on Nov. 15 (0204 GMT on Nov. 16), according to astronomy website In-The-Sky. The planets will be below the horizon for U.S. stargazers at the moment of their closest approach, but observers can catch the pair rising above the eastern horizon around midnight local time, just a few hours later.

Remember: You can discover the exact timings for the rising and setting of the planets above your local horizon using Time and Date's night sky tracker.

Jupiter will be the brightest of the pair, when it rises a little over 1 degree from the red light of Mars — roughly the width of your little finger held at arm's length against the night sky. The bright star Regulus will glow close at hand, forming the dot of the backward question mark formation of stars that represents the head of the great Lion in the constellation Leo.

Celestron StarSense Explorer LT114AZ

The Celestron StarSense Explorer LT114AZ is a great way to get a closer look at Jupiter, Mars and Saturn. Its 4.5-inch aperture and a high 1000mm focal length delivers good magnification out of the box, plus it's integrated with the StarSense smartphone app, which makes finding those planets so much easier. Check out our full review for more.

Mars and Jupiter will be close enough to share the field of view of a pair of 10x50 binoculars and will also make for a spectacular sight through the eyepiece of a telescope when viewed separately as they rise away from the horizon.

The gas giant's iconic Great Red Spot will rotate into view in the predawn hours of Nov. 16, and will be visible through a backyard telescope with an aperture of just 4 inches. Using a light green color filter will help increase the visibility of the vast storm, while an orange filter will help bring out detail in the gas giant's sweeping cloud belts.

The two planets will appear to gradually drift apart over the coming weeks and won't appear as close again for another 2.5 years in July 2029, when the two planets appear close together in the constellation Virgo.

Be sure to check out our guide to photographing the night sky, along with our picks of the best cameras and lenses for astrophotography if you're interested in following the dance of the planets for yourself.

Editor's Note: If you would like to share your astrophotography with Space.com's readers, then please send your photo(s), comments, and your name and location to spacephotos@space.com.

]]> <![CDATA[ Are the James Webb Space Telescope's mysterious Little Red Dots actually tiny black holes left over from the Big Bang era? ]]> Ever since NASA's James Webb Space Telescope (JWST) started observing the early universe, it has been providing almost as many surprises as it has answers. One such surprise are the so-called Little Red Dots, cosmic objects that seemingly disappear completely before the universe is two billion years old.

New research suggests that Little Red Dots may actually be connected primordial black holes, tiny black holes born not from dying stars but rather from fluctuations in the density of matter just after the Big Bang, in the earliest moments of cosmic history. Should they exist, primordial black holes would predate stars, galactic dust particles, and elements heavier than hydrogen and helium.

Now, researchers have used JWST data to test whether one particular Little Red Dot, known as blackAbell 2744-QSO1 (QSO1), could host a primordial black hole.

"A black hole is an object born from the gravitational death of a star. Primordial black holes are a very different story," study team member Valerio De Luca, of the Department of Physics and Astronomy at Johns Hopkins University (JHU) in Maryland, said in a statement.

"They come from the physics of the early universe that predates the first stars, when the universe was expanding exponentially in time and space. So the mechanisms for creating primordial black holes are different," De Luca added.

Little Red Dots could be the smoking gun of primordial black holes

Though scientists have theorized about the existence of primordial black holes since they were first proposed by Stephen Hawking in the 1970s, no hard evidence has presented itself. One of the issues scientists have puzzled over is how to tell the difference between a primordial black hole and a "traditional" or astrophysical black hole formed from the supernova death and collapse of a massive star.

"Little Red Dots could surround astrophysical black holes, and most probably many of them do, but they could also be primordial black holes, if primordial black holes exist," De Luca said. "So the question becomes, Which ones are primordial and how can we tell?"

De Luca and colleagues turned their attention to QS01, located around 13.1 billion light-years from Earth, which is seen as it was just 700 million years after the Big Bang. What makes this Little Red Dot stand out is the fact that it is almost entirely composed of hydrogen and helium. Because these were the universe's first elements, it could be more unspoiled and primordial than other Little Red Dots.

The team modeled how a Little Red Dot like QS01 could form from a primordial black hole. That was necessary because the circumstances under which this could happen would have to be very specific.

"There are constraints on primordial black holes from cosmological observations," said team member Loris Del Grosso, also of JHU's Department of Physics and Astronomy. "There can only be so many primordial black holes in the universe, for example, and there cannot be too many of them in a given cluster."

Considering three possible scenarios, the team found that the most likely situation is a smaller primordial black hole consuming surrounding gas and energy until it grew to be the size of QSO1.

"The door was open on this theory — that Little Red Dots could be primordial black holes," Del Grosso said. "We've now cracked it open a little farther by showing some scenarios are more likely than others."

Del Grosso and crew now intend to look at the other 100 or so Little Red Dots seen by the JWST to determine how many of them could have started life as primordial black holes.

Then scientists may finally have the evidence to say these long-theorized ancient black holes actually existed.

"We don't have a clear understanding of what happens in the early universe right after the Big Bang," De Luca concluded. "If primordial black holes do exist, then something had to happen to make them in the first place, which would be a groundbreaking discovery in physics."

The team's findings were published in June in the journal Physical Review Letters.

]]> <![CDATA[ NYT bestseller ‘Robopocalypse’ is getting a TV series with Oscar winners Ron Howard and Akiva Goldsman at the helm ]]> They say all good things come to those who wait… and WAIT. Well, the wait for "Robopocalypse" fans might finally be over, as Oscar winners Ron Howard and Akiva Goldsman have announced they're working on a TV adaptation.

It does seem like an eternity since news first broke that Portland-based New York Times bestselling author Daniel H. Wilson’s "Robopocalypse" (Doubleday, 2011) was bought by Steven Spielberg’s DreamWorks SKG for a sci-fi spectacle, with Drew Goddard ("The Martian") brought in to pen the screenplay.

That was back in 2009, and since then the story of a rogue AI named Archos and a hearty band of indigenous people in America’s heartland battling to save humanity from extinction has been placed on Hollywood’s back burner. After numerous stalled starts and director Michael Bay getting involved in 2018, "Robopocalypse" was quietly powered down due to script issues, filmmaker scheduling conflicts, and the enormous budget required.

But now we have been blessed with the news, first broken by The Hollywood Reporter, that Ron Howard ("Apollo 13," "The Da Vinci Code") and Akiva Goldsman ("A Beautiful Mind," "Star Trek: Strange New Worlds") have taken up the mantle of this chilling sci-fi project to develop as a new TV series. And what timing, just as AI fever has gripped the planet with paranoia centered around our eventual robot overlords.

"'Robopocalypse' has all the scale and suspense of a major action story, but what drew me to it are the thought-provoking themes and humanity at its center," Ron Howard shared in a statement.

"Daniel created a future that feels both startling and increasingly plausible, with characters who must figure out what connects us when the technology we rely on turns against us. I am also thrilled to work with Akiva again. We have shared some incredibly meaningful creative experiences, and this feels like the right story to bring us back together."

As a PhD graduate of Carnegie Mellon University’s Robotics Institute and a future king of the techno-thriller, Wilson was the ideal writer to bring this frightening story to life, and a 2014 sequel titled "Robogenesis" was equally gripping.

The prolific, award-winning writer has since set up a multitude of other Hollywood projects spawned from his catalog of works, including "Amped," "The Clockwork Dynasty," the authorized sequel to Michael Crichton's "The Andromeda Strain," "The Andromeda Evolution," and his 2025 alien invasion novel "Hole in the Sky," still alive at Netflix.

Howard's Imagine Entertainment will partner with Akiva Goldsman's Weed Road Pictures on this episodic adaptation, with Howard attached to direct the pilot episode and Goldsman serving as series showrunner.

"Robopocalypse" marks a creative reunion for the distinguished creators, following their collaborations on "A Beautiful Mind," "Cinderella Man," "The Da Vinci Code," and "Angels & Demons." Spielberg's Amblin Entertainment is slated to executive produce the ambitious show alongside Imagine's Brian Grazer and Jeb Brody and Weed's Rachel Wizenberg and Greg Lessans.

It's too early to tell which streaming service the "Robopocalypse" TV show will be attached to yet. Hopefully the pilot episode wows one of the big names, and we can finally see the "Robopocalypse" adaptation of our dreams.

In the meantime, we'd recommend checking out the original book by Daniel H. Wilson.

Controlled by a childlike—yet massively powerful—artificial intelligence known as Archos, the global network of machines on which our world has grown dependent suddenly becomes an implacable, deadly foe.View Deal

]]> <![CDATA[ Starfish Space loses contact with 1st 'Otter' servicing spacecraft, ending NASA tech-demo mission ]]> Starfish Space's first Otter has died, just a month after it reached the final frontier.

The Seattle startup announced on Tuesday (Nov. 3) that its Otter 24C satellite suffered a glitch in low Earth orbit (LEO) and is not recoverable.

The anomaly killed an ambitious mission in the cradle, as Otter 24C was still in the commissioning phase.

Otter 24C launched Oct. 1 on SpaceX's Transporter-18 mission, a rideshare flight that carried a total of 130 payloads to LEO (including a prototype satellite for Project Suncatcher, Google's planned AI constellation).

The Starfish satellite was flying a mission for NASA called Small Spacecraft Propulsion and Inspection Capability, or SSPICY for short. The goal was to "demonstrate technologies necessary for future debris-removal missions as well as for future applications in the servicing and inspection of active spacecraft," according to NASA's SSPICY site.

"This advances NASA's in-space manufacturing and assembly (ISAM) goals to ensure a sustainable space operating environment and builds towards a future where objects can be assembled, repaired and maintained in space, significantly expanding possibilities for science and human exploration," the agency added.

Starfish Space was a natural partner. The Seattle company plans to become a big player in the nascent field of satellite servicing, using its line of Otter craft to repair, refuel or deorbit other satellites for a variety of customers.

SSPICY marked Otter's spaceflight debut. The mission plan called for the 739-pound (335-kilogram) Otter 24C spacecraft to approach and inspect "up to four inoperable space objects of U.S. origin" over the course of a two-year mission, performing detailed visual inspections.

But Otter 24C never got the chance to perform any of these orbital rendezvous.

"While working through commissioning steps, Starfish eventually stopped receiving data from Otter 24C," the company said in a Nov. 3 X post.

"An investigation into the loss of communications has determined that fault protection on the satellite bus provided by [California company] Astro Digital had an error that turned off the radio and prevented re-establishing communications," Starfish added. "Starfish, NASA, and Astro Digital have concluded that Otter 24C is not recoverable."

The company further said that it's implementing fixes to reduce the chances that the problem will crop up in the future. And it stressed that Otter 24C's death will not be in vain.

"The work completed through Otter 24C will directly contribute to the success of future Otter missions, as Starfish continues developing the technologies and operations required to make satellite servicing a routine capability in orbit," Starfish said.

The Seattle company has other work to do in LEO at the moment as well: Its Otter Pup 2 prototype craft is currently gearing up to conduct a historic docking of its own in LEO.

Otter Pup 2, which launched in June 2025, has been getting closer and closer to another private spacecraft, Gilmour Space's ElaraSat. Last week, the company announced that Otter Pup 2 got within a mere 82 feet (25 meters) of its target.

"With this progress, Otter Pup 2 has officially completed Characterize, the penultimate phase of its mission. That leaves just one phase left: attempting docking, and a chance to make history," Starfish Space said in an Oct. 27 X post.

Two private satellites have docked before, but only much higher above Earth, in geostationary orbit. Such a meetup has not yet happened in LEO.

]]> <![CDATA[ NASA just launched a $1 million Moon Base Student Challenge to award cash prizes to students that solve lunar base problems ]]> CAPE CANAVERAL, Fla. — NASA has officially launched the Moon Base Student Challenge, asking students to help build humanity's future on the moon. And there's $1 million in prizes up for grabs for the winners.

To build and sustain a base on the moon, NASA will have to solve a myriad of problems. And they're looking to the next generation for help, the space agency's chief Jared Isaacman said Sunday (Nov. 8).

"We are inviting students from across the country to help solve some of the problems that stand between humanity and a permanent presence on another world," Isaacman said. "We're putting 1 million in prizes together to support the best ideas and recognize the teams behind them."

Isaacman made this announcement wearing his blue flight suit from the rocket garden at NASA's Kennedy Space Center Visitor Center amidst the agency's MAX POWER air show event. Just the day before, he flew fighter jets in that suit and even jumped out of a plane, skydiving into the event. Soon after this announcement, he was flying another fighter plane above the crowd.

The audience for this announcement was filled with students of all ages. Some young children wearing costume spacesuits squeezed as close as they could to the front of the room while teenagers considering their futures listened intently. It was clear that Isaacman's presence and words were landing with this group.

But what moon base challenges does NASA want to see these students tackle? In short, all of them.

"The moon base will allow us to conduct groundbreaking science, test new technologies, and prepare again for where we inevitably go next, which is the red planet," he said. "But before any of that can happen, we have an awful lot of problems that need to be solved."

"We need ways to generate power through the long lunar night. We need to protect our astronauts from that incredibly harsh and dangerous and demanding environment on the surface. We need to move people and equipment around on the surface and support human life three days away from Earth," Isaacman said, illustrating just a few of the big issues that present with the concept of a moon base.

How will it work?

This challenge is open to high school and post-secondary students based in the U.S. For participating students, they will form teams that will work on an idea from one of six different technical topics related to creating and running a moon base. These six topics include power systems, habitats, communications, mobility, life support and astronaut safety.

This will be what Isaacman described as a "multi-phase competition that mirrors how ideas are developed actually in the aerospace industry."

"Teams will first submit concepts, then they're going to refine them, and finalists will have the opportunity to present their solutions directly to NASA leaders and stakeholders," he further explained.

"The prize money is great for sure, but the the real opportunity is to work on problems NASA is actively trying to solve right now, so students don't need to wait to graduation to contribute to that effort," Isaacman added.

A long road ahead

Right now, NASA has a long road ahead of them before a moon base is actually built. In mid-2027, the agency is planning to launch its Artemis III mission which will see a crew of four astronauts practice rendezvous maneuvers with two different lunar landers. If all goes to plan, this will be followed by Artemis IV landing humans on the moon's surface for the first time since the final Apollo mission in 1972.

The agency is making these big steps forward to not just a crewed return to the moon, but a sustained, long-term return to the moon. However, knowing that a fully-fledged moon base is still firmly in the future, they are banking on the ingenuity, creativity and passion of

If you're a student or know a student interested in participating in this challenge, you can find more information on NASA's website here. Interested students can register until Jan. 25, 2027.

]]> <![CDATA[ Netflix announces 'Stranger Things' spin-off 'Other Worlds', and it's already teasing a trip to Area 51 (video) ]]>

So, you thought "Stranger Things" was done and dusted after all that Conformity Gate nonsense? No way! Netflix's sci-fi sensation returns in the live-action prequel series "Other Worlds: A Stranger Things Adventure."

Created by the Duffer Brothers and Kate Trefry, with the episodes set to be directed by Joe Wright ("Darkest Hour", "Black Mirror"), this new show isn't set in Hawkins or the electric '80s. No, this time around, the action takes place in Marion, Nevada, in 1955, and you know what else is located in Nevada, right? Area 51.

The teaser trailer certainly teases the possibility of a trip to the world's most paradoxically famous secret military base, showcasing a bike and radio resting outside of a fence with a sign that clearly says it's a restricted area (in any TV show or film, that's actually an invitation to see what's on the other side). Of course, the tease doesn't end there, as the thunder booms in the sky and there's a visual hint of a wormhole.

No story details about "Other Worlds: A Stranger Things Adventure" have been released to date, but there are some clues out there for all the Internet sleuths.

Trefrey wrote the Henry Creel-focused "Stranger Things: The First Shadow" play, while Matt Duffer explained to Variety how a spin-off show would tackle the rock that Henry found in the briefcase in "Stranger Things." So, yes, expect this to be a Henry-centric affair and the start of his long, hard road to hell and becoming Vecna.

What'll be interesting, though, is to see how the show ties into the history of Area 51. After all, it was on April 12, 1955, that CIA officer Richard Bissell discovered the site, while the "Other Worlds" trailer has the date of April 19th clearly marked onscreen, so the timelines align nicely here.

"Stranger Things" has never been shy of tying itself to real-world science and historical events, so it'll be fascinating to see how the show explores Area 51 as a concept and the secrets everybody believes are hidden there.

Was it really a site to test highly advanced weapons and aircraft, or was E.T.'s cousin held hostage there until he revealed Colonel Sanders' 11 herbs and spices? Who knows, with all this renewed excitement around this mysterious military facility, we might get another "Storm Area 51" event to enjoy and laugh at all over again.

Regardless, more "Stranger Things" is welcome news, and since it's presumably about one of the show's best characters, Henry Creel, it only adds another layer to his already intriguing lore. If we can't have an origin story about Hopper's incredible and envious moustache, this is the next best thing.

"Other Worlds: A Stranger Things Adventure" arrives on Netflix in 2028.

]]> <![CDATA[ NASA needs more astronauts for moon missions and beyond. You can apply now, but only until Dec. 3 ]]> If NASA ever hopes to build a permanent moon base for astronauts, let alone aim for Mars, the U.S. space agency is going to need a whole lot of space travelers. And now, you have a chance to be one of them.

NASA on Saturday (Nov. 7) put out the call for a new class of astronaut candidates who think they have the "right stuff" to fly, live and work in space. Those astronaut hopefuls have until Dec. 3 to apply (the application website is here), with NASA planning to make its final selections in late 2027.

"This is an extraordinary time to join NASA's astronaut corps," the space agency's chief, Jared Isaacman, said in an announcement, which was made during NASA's "Max Power" air show at Kennedy Space Center (KSC) in Florida. "The people we select could walk on the moon, live and work at the Moon Base, and help pioneer the systems and operations that will ultimately carry crews to Mars."

It's been two years since NASA last sought applications for astronauts. In 2024, more than 8,000 people applied, though only 10 — five men and five women — made the cut. They're in the middle of a two-year training program right now.

This new 2027 astronaut group will be the 25th astronaut class in NASA history. Its announcement comes the same year that NASA returned astronauts to the moon for the first time since the Apollo era with the Artemis II moon flyby. Four more astronauts will test Artemis moon landers in Earth orbit on the Artemis III mission in 2027.

NASA currently has 32 active astronauts in its spaceflying corps. The agency has recruited 370 people to fly in space since 1959, when the first seven Mercury astronauts were selected and unveiled to the world.

"There is a lot to be done in order to get all of these new vehicles and the new suits and everything as we continue to work towards the moon, build a base there, stay permanently, and then eventually onto Mars," NASA astronaut Nichole Stilwell, class of 2021, told Space.com in an interview at KSC during the Max Power event. "And so we just don't have enough people, and we're looking for more."

If you're interested in applying to be a NASA astronaut, you should take a look at the requirements first.

NASA's core guidelines require applicants to be U.S. citizens and have a master's degree in a STEM field like "engineering, biological science, physical science, or computer science from an accredited institution," the space agency said in a statement. You'll also need at least three years of experience in your related field.

Don't have a master's degree? Here's three other ways NASA might consider your application, according to the agency's advisory:

  • "Completion of at least two years of work toward a doctoral program in an appropriate technical field of engineering, biological science, physical science, computer science, or mathematics. 
  • "Completion of a Doctor of Medicine, Doctor of Osteopathic Medicine, Physician Assistant, Doctor of Nursing Practice, Family Nurse Practitioner, or a related medical degree. 
  • "Completion of, or current enrollment in, a nationally recognized Test Pilot School program, provided the program is completed by July 2027. If Test Pilot School is the only advanced technical degree, then completion of a bachelor’s degree in a STEM field, including engineering, biological science, physical science, or computer science is required."

If you're a medical doctor and are considering applying to be an astronaut, your residency training can be counted toward your professional experience, but only if it is completed by July 2027, NASA said.

If you want to be a pilot astronaut for NASA, you'll need some serious flight hours under your belt. Here's a rundown of some ways to meet that requirement:

  • 750 hours flying as pilot in command of high-performance jet aircraft.
  • 1,000 total flight hours in a rotary-wing aircraft, with 300 hours as pilot in command.
  • 1,500 total flight hours in other fixed-wing aircraft, with 750 hours as pilot in command.

"For those who apply, becoming a NASA astronaut is more than a career opportunity,” said NASA chief astronaut Scott Tingle, who also chairs the Astronaut Selection Board at the agency's Johnson Space Center (JSC) in Houston. "It is a chance to join a legacy of explorers who have pushed the boundaries of discovery and play a role in the missions that will shape humanity’s future in space."

Once NASA selects its 2027 astronaut class, the new recruits can expect to begin a two-year training program based out of JSC, which is home to the agency's astronaut corp and Mission Control.

“The window is open. The mission is waiting.," NASA Deputy Administrator Matt Anderson said in a statement. "And the only thing missing from the greatest adventure humanity has ever embarked upon is you."

Space.com Content Manager Chelsea Gohd contributed to this report from NASA's Max Power event at the Kennedy Space Center in Cape Canaveral, Florida.

]]> <![CDATA[ SpaceX will launch epic double-catch Starship Flight 15 test mission on Nov. 13 ]]>

SpaceX will make spaceflight history this week, if all goes according to plan.

The company announced over the weekend that it's targeting Friday (Nov. 13) for the 15th test flight of its Starship megarocket, which will attempt something that's never been done before.

"The upcoming flight is planned to be the first to return both Starship and Super Heavy to the launch site for catch," SpaceX wrote in a description of Flight 15. "If successful, this will mark the first full recovery of an orbital launch system and a breakthrough moment in making Starship a reliable, rapidly reusable rocket."

Super Heavy is Starship's giant booster, and Starship (or Ship for short) is its upper-stage spacecraft. As SpaceX's description noted, both elements are designed to be fully and rapidly reusable.

"Catch" refers to SpaceX's recovery mechanism for both stages: Each will return to the launch mount at SpaceX's Starbase site in South Texas and be plucked out of the sky by the tower's "chopstick" arms.

SpaceX has caught Super Heavy on three Starship flights to date, but it has never tried the maneuver with Ship. It's a taller order; Ship flies higher and farther than Super Heavy, so its return to Earth is more complex and energetic.

SpaceX founder and CEO Elon Musk already told us that Flight 15 would likely feature a double-catch attempt. But the newly released mission description gives us a launch date, as well as details about the flight.

Starship Die Cast Rocket Model Was $47.99 Now $39.99 on Amazon.

Even if you can't see SpaceX's Starship in person, you can score a model of your own. Standing at 13.77 inches (35 cm), this is a 1:375 ratio of SpaceX's Starship as a desktop model. The materials here are alloy steel and it weighs just 225g.View Deal

Flight 15 is scheduled to launch from Starbase on Friday during a 75-minute window that opens at 5:45 p.m. EST (2245 GMT; 4:45 p.m. local Texas time).

Super Heavy will come back to Starbase for its tower catch about 6.5 minutes after liftoff, if all goes to plan. But Ship will stay up quite a bit longer.

The upper stage will go orbital, something Starship did for the first time on Flight 14 on Sept. 28. And, as on Flight 14, Ship will deploy 26 of SpaceX's next-gen Starlink V3 satellites, the vanguard of a new megaconstellation that will eventually consist of about 100,000 spacecraft, according to Musk.

But Ship should stay aloft for much longer on Flight 15 than it did on Flight 14, which ended with a splashdown in the northern Pacific Ocean about three hours after liftoff.

"Starship’s initial return to launch site mission is expected to orbit the Earth at an altitude of ~275 km [171 miles] and complete approximately 14 orbits around the planet over the course of a more than 22-hour flight," SpaceX wrote in its description of Flight 15.

"Similar to Starship’s first orbital mission, the flight profile has been designed with the opportunity to insert into a passively safe suborbital trajectory or safely deorbit at multiple pre-determined areas over the ocean after raising to an orbital altitude," the company added.

So there's no guarantee that Ship will indeed come back to Starbase for a catch on Flight 15; SpaceX will call off the try if anything is amiss. Whatever happens, however, you should definitely tune in. It's not every day, after all, that you can watch a rocket the size of a 40-story building take flight.

]]> <![CDATA[ Meteorite that landed in Cape Cod was a 'lone wolf' from the outer solar system, scientists find ]]> Thanks to a combination of radar, infrasound, dash-cam and security camera footage, astronomers have tracked the bright daytime meteor that fell over Cape Cod Bay in May 2026 back to its origin as a small asteroid perturbed by Jupiter and sent on a comet-like orbit towards Earth.

Meteor fireballs visible in the daytime are referred to as 'bolides'. At 1:06 p.m. local time (18:06 UTC) on May 30, 2026 one such bolide was widely witnessed falling out of the sky over coastal Massachusetts, with members of the public also reporting an associated sonic boom that rumbled across the north-eastern coast of the United States.

Now, a team of scientists from Europe and the United States, led by space physicist Juha Vierinen of the Arctic University of Norway in Tromsø, have patched together measurements from a meteor-observing radar network, regular weather radar, infrasound stations and camera footage to fully characterize the fall of this meteoroid and trace its orbit around the sun.

Key to these observations were measurements by the Spread Spectrum Interferometric Meteor Observing Network (SIMONe) based at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology's (MIT's) Haystack Observatory. SIMONe is a project jointly developed by MIT, the Arctic University of Norway and the Leibniz Institute of Atmospheric Physics in Kühlungsborn, Germany.

"We were fortunate that the event occurred within the coverage of SIMONe," Vierinen told Space.com.

This is echoed by Ryan Volz, a radio scientist at Haystack Observatory who is a member of the team who studied the May 30 bolide. "We got pretty lucky to observe this one," Volz told Space.com. "A bolide like this would have to enter the atmosphere within about 62 miles (100 kilometers) of a SIMONe-like meteor radar system for the head echoes we saw to be detectable, and there are only a handful of places in the world that currently meet that criteria."

A head echo is what radar sees when a meteoroid – what we call the lump of rock that becomes a meteor while it is still in space – enters Earth's atmosphere, generating a cloud of plasma around it as it superheats the atmosphere and its outer surface.

"The head echoes give the best constraints on the meteoroid's trajectory," said Volz.

The existence of the head echo is usually very brief, taking place at 56 miles (90 kilometers () altitude down to about 44 miles (71 kilometers) when the plasma around the meteoroid is dense enough to return a radar echo. The head echo transitions into a 'trail echo', which is produced by a streak of turbulent plasma that is left in the wake of the meteoroid after it has passed through a given part of the atmosphere.

In the case of the 30 May bolide, the trail echo was detected down to an unusually low altitude of 20 miles (32 kilometers), at which point the falling rock fragmented with an explosive force equivalent to 500 tons of TNT, whereas the total impact energy of the bolide was in the region on 1.1 kilotons of TNT. Only three recorded bolides around the world had a greater impact energy in the year before (2025), giving an indication of how rare such events are.

At this point, four of the Next Generation Weather Radars (NEXRAD) jointly operated by the National Weather Service, the Federal Aviation Administration and the U.S. Air Force took over, recording the debris from the fragmentation as solid chunks of rock fell as meteorites into Cape Cod Bay.

The radar detections were supported by infrasound readings of the atmospheric pressure waves resulting from the hypervelocity fall and break-up of the object. These pressure waves can travel hundreds or thousands of kilometers and were picked up by the Elginfield Infrasound Array (ELFO) in Ontario, Canada, as well as by citizen scientists operating their own Raspberry Shake/Boom pressure sensors, which are build-your-own micro-barometers produced by the Raspberry Pi Foundation.

"Six citizen-operated sensors jointly constrained the arrival direction," said Vierinen. "Five other single-station detections and ELFO supplied the signal periods used to estimate the energy release. We are grateful to the citizen scientists whose measurements expanded the coverage and helped locate the event."

From the data gathered, the team were able to deduce certain properties about the object that fell to Earth over Massachusetts. The meteoroid that entered the atmosphere was about a meter (approximately three feet) across, and based on how deep it penetrated into the atmosphere before fragmenting it must have been a pretty solid body, possibly rich in iron.

"We cannot determine its exact history, but we found no association with any known meteor shower," said Vierinen.

Extrapolating its trajectory back into space, the team found that the meteoroid had a comet-like elongated orbit around the sun that took it almost as far out as Jupiter. Comets on such orbits are referred to as Jupiter-family comets, since their orbits are governed by perturbations from Jupiter's powerful gravitational influence.

However, the meteoroid was definitely not a comet, and previous research has found that Jupiter can draw out small asteroids from the main asteroid belt between Mars and Jupiter and place them on such orbits.

"Meteoroids can be perturbed by other bodies including Jupiter," team-member Marc Fries told Space.com. "The meteoroid's aphelion – the point where it is farthest from the sun – is close to Jupiter's orbit, which suggests a close pass by the gas giant may have indeed flung it into its recent Earth-crossing path. This same process has slowly depopulated the asteroid belt throughout the solar system's history."

Meteoroids on meter-sized scales are in something of a black spot – they are not very easy to detect in space from Earth unlike larger asteroids, and they are not common enough to be falling to Earth all the time unlike the pebble-sized meteoroids and smaller that burn up as shooting stars. As such, we know relatively little about this population of bodies and every bolide that we see helps us to learn more.

"Every new piece of data we glean about Earth impactors adds to the statistics," said Fries. "It is especially helpful to have measurements of total power, location, originating orbit and similar data points for the more massive meteorites, because those are the meteoroids and asteroids we encounter less frequently."

That the meteoroid fell over such a highly populated area was a stroke of luck. Although the atmosphere is carefully monitored on a global basis by both ground stations and satellites high above us, meaning that even if a meteor streaks above an uninhabited area there is usually enough data to narrow down its trajectory somewhat, radar observations are able to do so more accurately.

"We would love to have global coverage with meteor radar networks and we and others are making progress with SIMONe and similar systems, but the current coverage is still sparse," said Volz.

Nevertheless, the Cape Cod bolide resoundingly shows that by combining radar echoes from head and trail plasma with weather radar observations and ultrasound pulses from the break-up of falling rocks, scientists can ascertain the orbits of impacting meteoroids very accurately.

While the Cape Cod meteoroid was much smaller than the asteroid that exploded over Chelyabinsk in 2013, which was about 18 meters across and exploded with an energy equivalent to between 400 and 500 kilotons of TNT, being able to trace meteoroids back to their orbits may in future reveal new populations of potentially hazardous impactors.

The research into the Cape Cod bolide is available as a preprint on the arXiv server.

 <link>https://www.irozhlas.cz/zpravy-domov/ondrej-tichy-z-ods-je-novym-primatorem-pardubic-zvoleni-byli-take-namestci-bude_2611091851_aln</link>
 <description>Primátorem Pardubic se stal Ondřej Tichý z ODS. Na pondělním ustavujícím zasedání zastupitelstva města pro něj hlasovalo 23 zastupitelů z 39. Zastupitelé zvolili taky primátorovy náměstky, kterých bude pět. Ve vedení města po dvanácti letech končí hnutí ANO. Přestože letošní volby vyhrálo, nepodařilo se mu sestavit většinovou koalici. 
</description>

</item>
<item>
 <title>‚Dal jsem si do branky vlastní gól.‘ Ministr Macinka se omluvil za výroky o hokejistkách</title>
 <link>https://www.irozhlas.cz/zpravy-domov/dal-jsem-si-do-branky-vlastni-gol-ministr-macinka-se-omluvil-za-vyroky-o_2611091849_jos</link>
 <description>Ministr zahraničí Petr Macinka (Motoristé) se omluvil za své výroky, ve kterých označil hokej za mužský sport. V souvislosti s jednáním o startu ruských hráček na mistrovství světa kategorie do 18 let také dříve uvedl, že feministky budou muset přežít akci „bez ruských mužatek“. Macinka v pondělí po jednání vlády uznal, že jeho vyjádření bylo velmi nevhodné, a řekl, že ho to mrzí.</description>

</item>

 <description>Ministr obrany Jaromír Zůna (SPD) odvolal brigádního generála Radka Haratka z velení kybernetických a informačních sil.   <item>
   <title>Mají se Češi bát salmonely? Kontroly jsou teď důkladnější, situace bývala horší</title>
   <link>https://www.denik.cz/zdravotnictvi/cesko-zdravi-salmonela-maso-vajicka-priznaky-dieta/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=feed-vse&utm_campaign=ceskolipsky.denik.cz&utm_content=zdravotnictvi</link>
   <description>V posledních týdnech se v Česku často skloňuje salmonela. Odborníci ze Státní zemědělské a potravinářské inspekce a Státní veterinární správy totiž tuto bakterii opakovaně našli v kuřecím mase, které nabízely některé supermarkety. Ty ho následně ze svých prodejen stáhly. Hojně medializován byl i případ základní školy v Praze 21-Újezdu nad Lesy, kde se ze stravy nakazily stovky dětí salmonelózou. Deník.cz přináší srovnání současné situace s minulými lety, informace o nemoci i tipy na jídla po prodělané nákaze.</description>
   <pubDate>Mon, 09 Nov 2026 16:30:00 +0100</pubDate>
   <guid>https://www.denik.cz/zdravotnictvi/cesko-zdravi-salmonela-maso-vajicka-priznaky-dieta/</guid>

  </item>
  <item>
   <title>Nezaměstnanost v Libereckém kraji rostla. Přibylo ale i pracovních příležitostí</title>
   <link>https://ceskolipsky.denik.cz/zpravy-region/nezamestnanost-v-libereckem-kraji-rostla-pribylo-ale-i-pracovnich-prilezitosti/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=feed-vse&utm_campaign=ceskolipsky.denik.cz&utm_content=zpravy-region</link>
   <description>Podzimní ochlazení na pracovním trhu se začíná projevovat také v Libereckém kraji. V říjnu zde počet lidí bez práce opět vzrostl, a to napříč všemi okresy. Úřad práce evidoval celkem 17 555 uchazečů o zaměstnání, což je o 200 více než v září a o 1 227 více než před rokem. Podíl nezaměstnaných tak dosáhl 5,7 procenta.</description>
   <pubDate>Mon, 09 Nov 2026 14:45:37 +0100</pubDate>
   <guid>https://ceskolipsky.denik.cz/zpravy-region/nezamestnanost-v-libereckem-kraji-rostla-pribylo-ale-i-pracovnich-prilezitosti/</guid>
   <category>Českolipsko </category>
   <enclosure url="https://ceskolipsky.denik.cz/images/api/image/1366x768/a3c/a3ca8da6-4685-4315-a062-61fa69e2bf45.jpeg" length="0" type="image/jpeg"/>
   <media:content url="https://ceskolipsky.denik.cz/images/api/image/1366x768/a3c/a3ca8da6-4685-4315-a062-61fa69e2bf45.jpeg" medium="image" height="768" width="1366">
    <media:description>Když přijdete o zaměstnání a splníte požadované podmínky, stát vám vyplatí podporu v nezaměstnanosti. Jak dlouho ji budete dostávat a v jaké výši se odvíjí od vašeho věku.</media:description>
    <media:credit>Wikimedia Commons/Czeva/ CC BY-SA 3.0</media:credit>
   </media:content>
  </item>
  <item>
   <title>Zemřela mi tam přítelkyně, svěřil se muž z Doks po požáru budovy u zámku</title>
   <link>https://ceskolipsky.denik.cz/zpravy-region/pozar-doksy-zamek-bezdomovec-obeti/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=feed-vse&utm_campaign=ceskolipsky.denik.cz&utm_content=zpravy-region</link>
   <description>Zanedbaná budova v areálu zámku v Doksech se o víkendu stala dějištěm tragédie. V sobotu večer tam zasahující u požáru našli dvě těla bez známek života. Reportérka Deníku se na místě v pondělí kolem poledne potkala s mužem, který měl slzy v očích. V troskách podle jeho slov zemřela žena, kterou označuje za svou přítelkyni. Přišel zkontrolovat, že hoří svíčky, které tu pro ni ráno pietně zapálil.</description>
   <pubDate>Mon, 09 Nov 2026 14:03:49 +0100</pubDate>
   <guid>https://ceskolipsky.denik.cz/zpravy-region/pozar-doksy-zamek-bezdomovec-obeti/</guid>

    <media:description>Tragická událost na začátku listopadu v Doksech si vyžádala dvě lidské oběti.</media:description>

  <item>
   <title>Tušili jsme, že někoho zabije, řekla spolužačka. Střelec z Polska měl sešit katů</title>
   <link>https://www.denik.cz/evropa/polsko-krakov-strelec-si-maloval-do-sesitu-katy-spoluzaci-ze-skoly-byli-vydeseni/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=feed-vse&utm_campaign=ceskolipsky.denik.cz&utm_content=evropa</link>
   <description>Bývalá spolužačka popsala čtyřiadvacetiletého Michała O., který v sobotu v polském Krakově zastřelil šest lidí a dalších nejméně šestnáct zranil. Vzpomínala na znepokojivé kresby katů a ozbrojenců v jeho sešitech i na podivné chování. Spolu s dalšími žáky už během školních let vtipkoval, že jednou někoho zabije.</description>

    <item>
      <title>Největší účast v jeho životě. Na papežovu mši v Buenos Aires šly miliony lidí</title>
      <link>https://www.idnes.cz/zpravy/zahranicni/mse-papez-lev-buenos-aires-miliony-lide-argentina-cesta-davy.A261109_170240_zahranicni_fohl#utm_source=rss&utm_medium=feed&utm_campaign=zpravodaj&utm_content=main</link>
      <description>Pondělní mše s papežem Lvem XIV. v argentinské metropoli Buenos Aires se zúčastnilo 2,5 milionu lidí, uvedl Vatikán. Místní úřady dříve odhadly počet přítomných na dva miliony lidí, píší média. Papež je druhým dnem v Argentině, kde dříve navštívil také středisko péče o postižené, jehož fungování ohrožují vládní škrty. Za zavřenými dveřmi se pak setkal i s oběťmi sexuálního násilí v církevním prostředí.</description>

      <description>Pondělní výbuch v ocelárně na západě Turecka zabil 16 lidí, řekl odpoledne turecký prezident Recep Tayyip Erdogan, který také slíbil prošetřit příčiny tragédie. <title>Papírové žádanky mají definitivně skončit. Lékaři mají přejít na elektronické, stát jim na to dá čas do léta</title>
<link>https://www.lupa.cz/aktuality/papirove-zadanky-maji-definitivne-skoncit-lekari-maji-prejit-na-elektronicke-stat-jim-na-to-da-cas-do-leta/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=text&utm_campaign=rss</link>
<description>Elektronické žádanky (eŽádanky) na vy&#353;etření mají v Česku přejít z dobrovolného režimu do povinného. Od července pří&#353;tího roku mají mít lékaři povinnost elektronicky vystavovat žádanky na část vy&#353;etření, uvádí novela zákona o elektronizaci zdravotnictví, kterou schválila vláda. Projít je&#353;tě musí Sněmovnou, pokud se tak stane, od ledna 2028 se povinnost roz&#353;íří také na laboratorní žádanky. A od dal&#353;ího roku budou zdravotníci povinně vést elektronicky i zdravotnickou dokumentaci.</description>

<description>V Česku se dnes schvalovaly dva projekty, které mají podle představ vlády pomoct s rozvojem AI v zemi. Vznikl nový orgán, jímž je Rada vlády pro umělou inteligenci. Ta má koordinovat postup státu a spolupráci s výzkumníky a firmami a mezi její členy patří například rektor ČVUT Michal Pěchouček nebo zakladatel Aisle Ondřej Vlček. Vedle toho dnes vláda odsouhlasila návrh zákona, který má určit, kdo bude v Česku dohlížet na dodržování evropských pravidel pro umělou inteligenci a jak budou kontroly fungovat.</description>

<title>Konec zaostávání? EU rozdá miliardy na návrh vlastních čipů, projekt pomohli vytvořit Češi</title>
<link>https://www.lupa.cz/aktuality/konec-zaostavani-eu-rozda-miliardy-na-navrh-vlastnich-cipu-projekt-pomohli-vytvorit-cesi/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=text&utm_campaign=rss</link>
<description>Takzvaný evropský zákon o čipech (Chips Act) sice nezvládl cíl zvý&#353;it klesající podíl Evropy ve výrobě čipů, ale několik továren přece jen vzniklo či vzniká. Rozjely se i dal&#353;í aktivity, které Chips Act obsahuje. Jde třeba o takzvané pilotní linky, kde je možné vyrábět prototypu čipů, včetně jedné nejpokročilej&#353;í na světě (pod dva nanometry v IMEC v Belgii). Teď odstatovala i European Chips Design Platform (EuroCDP) zpřístupňující software pro návrh čipů z jednoho místa.</description>

 <title>Evropa bude prvním klimaticky neutrálním kontinentem, věří Miko. Začíná COP31 v Antalyi</title>
 <link>https://www.irozhlas.cz/zpravy-svet/evropa-bude-prvnim-klimaticky-neutralnim-kontinentem-veri-miko-zacina-cop31-v_2611092232_lbl</link>
 <description>Začala klimatická konference COP31, jež se koná v turecké Antalyi. Má se na ní diskutovat o boji proti globálnímu oteplování a dalších tématech. „Věřím, že Evropa bude prvním velkým územním celkem, který bude klimaticky neutrální,“ říká pro Radiožurnál přírodovědec a exministr životního prostředí Ladislav Miko. „Když se podíváte na země, které za poslední období dokázaly snížit emise, byť z obrovského základu, je to paradoxně Čína a USA,“ dodává.</description>

<item>
 <title>Výtržníci ve Francii si přisvojují protesty, bez nepokojů by ale vláda asi nereagovala, míní Šmíd</title>
 <link>https://www.irozhlas.cz/zpravy-svet/vytrznici-ve-francii-si-prisvojuji-protesty-bez-nepokoju-ale-vlada-asi_2611091911_lbl</link>
 <description>Protesty kvůli vysokým životním nákladům, nekvalitnímu školství a veřejným službám trvají ve Francii už déle než měsíc. Ke studentům se připojili odbory a státní zaměstnanci. Významnou roli hrají výtržníci, od nichž se ostatní skupiny distancují. „Kdyby ale nedošlo k výrazným nepokojům, útokům na policisty a rabování, tak by asi vláda na ty požadavky nereagovala,“ říká v rozhovoru pro Český rozhlas Plus pařížský zpravodaj České televize Jan Šmíd.</description>

</item>
<item>

 <link>https://www.irozhlas.cz/zpravy-svet/telefonat-do-kremlu-odhalil-slabinu-evropy-chybi-ji-silny-a-jednotny-hlas-pise_2611091809_eml</link>
 <description>Lídři Finska a Norska se po telefonátu do Moskvy dočkali kritiky od svých evropských spojenců. Mnohým vadí nedostatek koordinace a tvrdí, že poskytování diplomatické půdy Rusku pouze nahrává prezidentovi Vladimiru Putinovi. Evropa nicméně stále nemůže najít lepší způsob, jak ovlivnit mírové rozhovory amerického prezidenta Donalda Trumpa, píše server Politico. </description>

 <description>Ruská delegace odletěla do Abú Zabí na jednání se zástupci Ukrajiny a Spojených států, oznámila v pondělí ruská státní agentura TASS. Rozhovory o ukončení války Ruska proti Ukrajině, která pokračuje pátý rok, se budou konat v úterý a ve středu. Na cestě do Abú Zabí je také ukrajinská delegace, informoval šéf civilní rozvědky Rustem Umerov, který stojí v jejím čele.</description>
 <enclosure url="https://www.irozhlas.cz/sites/default/files/styles/zpravy_maly_nahled/public/uploader/2026-11-07t131337z_6_261109-172708_ako.JPG?itok=kpdhNPI1" type="image/jpeg" />

</item>
<item>
 <title>Co dělat, když se na veřejnosti střílí? ‚Nesnažit si věc natáčet nebo eliminovat hrozbu,’ doporučuje expert</title>
 <link>https://www.irozhlas.cz/zpravy-svet/co-delat-kdyz-se-na-verejnosti-strili-nesnazit-si-vec-natacet-nebo-eliminovat_2611091628_raf</link>
 <description>Polsko již druhým dnem drží státní smutek za oběti střelby v centru Krakova. Útočník v sobotu zavraždil šest lidí a dalších 15 zranil. Střelec v pondělí ráno zemřel v nemocnici. Jak se mají lidé chovat v případě střelby na veřejném prostranství? „Vylézt někam na vršek a podívat se, odkud střelba pochází, asi není úplně dobrý nápad,“ říká pro Radiožurnál bezpečnostní expert Stanislav Kazbunda ze soukromé školy Trivis.</description>
 <enclosure url="https://www.irozhlas.cz/sites/default/files/styles/zpravy_maly_nahled/public/uploader/dsc_3538_261005-112911_jar.jpg?itok=fmTY6LcC" type="image/jpeg" />
 <pubDate>Mon, 09 Nov 2026 16:28:00 +0100</pubDate>
</item>
<item>
 <title>‚Můžu na ně zavzpomínat a vzdát jim hold.‘ Británie si připomněla válečné veterány, nechyběli ani Češi</title>
 <link>https://www.irozhlas.cz/zpravy-svet/muzu-na-ne-zavzpominat-a-vzdat-jim-hold-britanie-si-pripomnela-valecne-veterany_2611091525_cen</link>
 <description>Velká Británie si připomněla válečné veterány. Po celé zemi se odehrála řada vzpomínkových pochodů a shromáždění, která připomínají padlé vojáky a válečné veterány. Hlavní pieta se odehrála za účasti královské rodiny v centru Londýna a po desáté se jí zúčastnili i čeští veteráni.</description>
 <enclosure url="https://www.irozhlas.cz/sites/default/files/styles/zpravy_maly_nahled/public/uploader/jmv1_261109-115107_cen.jpg?itok=1iZfFgAW" type="image/jpeg" />
 <pubDate>Mon, 09 Nov 2026 15:25:00 +0100</pubDate>
</item>
<item>
 <title>V Maďarsku byl zatčen expremiérův bratr, Viktor Orbán to označil za útok na sebe</title>
 <link>https://www.irozhlas.cz/zpravy-svet/v-madarsku-byl-zatcen-expremieruv-bratr-viktor-orban-oznacil-za-utok-na-sebe_2611091318_cen</link>
 <description>Maďarské úřady zadržely Árona Orbána, bratra někdejšího dlouholetého premiéra Viktora Orbána, a to kvůli podezření z pašování lidí. V pondělí o tom informovala maďarská média. Expremiér Orbán, který je lídrem nyní opoziční strany Fidesz, prohlásil, že skutečným cílem této operace je on sám, napsala agentura MTI.</description>
 <enclosure url="https://www.irozhlas.cz/sites/default/files/styles/zpravy_maly_nahled/public/uploader/2026-07-22t144647z_1_260820-124516_ako.JPG?itok=UwkaBhbi" type="image/jpeg" />
 <pubDate>Mon, 09 Nov 2026 13:18:00 +0100</pubDate>
</item>
<item>
 <title>Nerad: AGILE je první vlaštovkou rychlých inovací v obraně Evropské unie</title>
 <link>https://www.irozhlas.cz/zpravy-svet/nerad-agile-je-prvni-vlastovkou-rychlych-inovaci-v-obrane-evropske-unie_2611091036_cen</link>
 <description>Za necelé dva měsíce začne fungovat nový obranný projekt Evropské unie AGILE. Malým a středním podnikům má umožnit hlásit se o milionové granty s projekty, které mohou najít využití u evropských armád. „Představa je taková, že finální nasazení by mělo nastat do roku, maximálně tří let. To je v porovnání s klasickým zaváděním obranných technologií neskutečně rychlé,“ uvedl v pořadu Bruselské chlebíčky analytik Filip Nerad.</description>
 <enclosure url="https://www.irozhlas.cz/sites/default/files/styles/zpravy_maly_nahled/public/images/357a78625fb58acfda9ad9ea7be1ef29.jpg?itok=eOdnp2u3" type="image/jpeg" />

</item>
<item>
 <title>‚Byl jsem nevěrný své manželce.’ Šéf Nvidie navázal vztah s čínskou špionkou, firma ho prověřuje</title>
 <link>https://www.irozhlas.cz/zpravy-svet/byl-jsem-neverny-sve-manzelce-sef-nvidie-navazal-vztah-s-cinskou-spionkou-firma_2611090856_raf</link>
 <description>Americký výrobce čipů Nvidia vyšetřuje zprávy o tom, že jeho šéf Jensen Huang navázal vztah se ženou, která je podezřelá ze špionáže pro Čínu. Oznámila to firma. Nvidia patří mezi nejhodnotnější podniky na světě a dominuje globálnímu trhu s čipy pro umělou inteligenci (AI). Třiašedesátiletý Huang podle agentury Bloomberg vztah s touto ženou přiznal.</description>
 <enclosure url="https://www.irozhlas.cz/sites/default/files/styles/zpravy_maly_nahled/public/uploader/2026-10-08t175515z_1_261109-083913_raf.JPG?itok=l_tvidSu" type="image/jpeg" />

</item>
<item>
 <title>Zemřel muž, který v Krakově zabil šest lidí. Téměř všichni zranění jsou ve stabilizovaném stavu</title>
 <link>https://www.irozhlas.cz/zpravy-svet/zemrel-utocnik-z-krakova-v-centru-mesta-zabil-sest-lidi_2611090715_raf</link>
 <description>Útočník, který v sobotu v centru Krakova zabil šest lidí a dalších 15 zranil, v pondělí ráno v nemocnici zemřel, informuje na síti X polská policie. Podle stanice TVN 24 informaci potvrdil Krzysztof Klenczar, jenž stojí v čele Malopolského vojvodství se správním centrem Krakovem. Policisté útočníka po činu postřelili. Muž podle prokuratury zřejmě také zastřelil další tři lidi: své rodiče a sestru. Jejich těla byla nalezena v jeho bytě.</description>

<description>Elektronické žádanky (eŽádanky) na vy&#353;etření mají v Česku přejít z dobrovolného režimu do povinného. Od července pří&#353;tího roku mají mít lékaři povinnost elektronicky vystavovat žádanky na část vy&#353;etření, uvádí novela zákona o elektronizaci zdravotnictví, kterou schválila vláda. Projít je&#353;tě musí Sněmovnou, pokud se tak stane, od ledna 2028 se povinnost roz&#353;íří také na laboratorní žádanky. A od dal&#353;ího roku budou zdravotníci povinně vést elektronicky i zdravotnickou dokumentaci.</description>

Soud zamítl stížnost, zastupitelé usednou 19. listopadu</title><link>https://liberecka.drbna.cz/politika/905350-soud-zamitl-navrh-na-neplatnost-hlasovani-ve-volbach-v-liberci.html</link><guid isPermaLink="true">https://liberecka.drbna.cz/politika/905350-soud-zamitl-navrh-na-neplatnost-hlasovani-ve-volbach-v-liberci.html</guid><pubDate>Mon, 09 Nov 2026 18:55:00 +0100</pubDate><dc:creator>ČTK</dc:creator><category>Politika</category><description>Soud v pondělí 9. listopadu zamítl návrh na neplatnost hlasování v komunálních volbách v Liberci. Návrh končícího náměstka primátora Adama Lenerta (ANO) byl založen jen na statistických odchylkách, soud ho odmítl jako nedůvodný, vyplývá z rozhodnutí na úřední desce pobočky krajského soudu v Liberci.</description></item><item><title>Liberecké gymnastky září. Z MČR vezou stříbro, doma vybojovaly dvě zlata</title><link>https://liberecka.drbna.cz/ostatni-sporty/905310-liberecke-gymnastky-zari-z-mcr-vezou-stribro-doma-vybojovaly-dve-zlata.html</link><guid isPermaLink="true">https://liberecka.drbna.cz/ostatni-sporty/905310-liberecke-gymnastky-zari-z-mcr-vezou-stribro-doma-vybojovaly-dve-zlata.html</guid><pubDate>Mon, 09 Nov 2026 18:00:00 +0100</pubDate><dc:creator>Martina Petrášková</dc:creator><category>Ostatní sporty</category><description>Podzimní závodní sezona je v plném proudu a gymnastky z oddílu Sportovní gymnastika Liberec mají za sebou další úspěšná vystoupení. Na mistrovství České republiky v Lounech získaly stříbrnou medaili, na domácím Ještědském poháru přidaly dvě vítězství. A další důležité závody je čekají.</description></item><item><title>Pohyb s dětmi v městském provozu? Dopravní podnik pozval preventisty z celého Česka</title><link>https://liberecka.drbna.cz/doprava/905075-pohyb-s-detmi-v-mestskem-provozu-dopravni-podnik-pozval-preventisty-z-celeho-ceska.html</link><guid isPermaLink="true">https://liberecka.drbna.cz/doprava/905075-pohyb-s-detmi-v-mestskem-provozu-dopravni-podnik-pozval-preventisty-z-celeho-ceska.html</guid><pubDate>Mon, 09 Nov 2026 16:45:00 +0100</pubDate><category>Doprava</category><description>Na šest desítek policejních preventistů přišlo do libereckého dopravního podniku. Důvod? Aby si na vlastní kůži vyzkoušeli a osahali, jak se pohybovat v blízkosti zastávek MHD, autobusů a tramvají. Své zkušenosti pak předají ve školách a školkách.</description></item><item><title>Speciální tričko pro řidiče z Liberce má vylepšenou verzi</title><link>https://liberecka.drbna.cz/spolecnost/905275-specialni-tricko-pro-ridice-z-liberce-ma-vylepsenou-verzi.html</link><guid isPermaLink="true">https://liberecka.drbna.cz/spolecnost/905275-specialni-tricko-pro-ridice-z-liberce-ma-vylepsenou-verzi.html</guid><pubDate>Mon, 09 Nov 2026 15:00:00 +0100</pubDate><dc:creator>Luboš Vrabec</dc:creator><category>Společnost</category><description>Vědci z liberecké univerzity loni představili tričko se senzory, které dokáže podle dechu řidičky nebo řidiče rozpoznat nastupující nebezpečnou únavu dříve, než hrozí mikrospánek. Vývoj ale pokračoval a nyní proběhlo testování druhé verze trika.</description></item><item><title>Stovky cejnů i osmikiloví kapři šli z vody. Zoo Liberec zachraňuje Labutí jezírko</title><link>https://liberecka.drbna.cz/spolecnost/905302-stovky-cejnu-i-osmikilovi-kapri-sli-z-vody-zoo-liberec-zachranuje-labuti-jezirko.html</link><guid isPermaLink="true">https://liberecka.drbna.cz/spolecnost/905302-stovky-cejnu-i-osmikilovi-kapri-sli-z-vody-zoo-liberec-zachranuje-labuti-jezirko.html</guid><pubDate>Mon, 09 Nov 2026 13:00:00 +0100</pubDate><dc:creator>Martina Petrášková</dc:creator><category>Společnost</category><description>Stovky cejnů, osmikilové kapry i škeble museli rybáři odchytit z vypuštěného Labutího jezírka v Zoo Liberec. Historické vodní ploše z roku 1900 hrozila havárie hráze, a tak ji čeká rozsáhlá rekonstrukce za 20 milionů korun. Vznikne tu i nový ostrov, který se stane domovem pro další skupinu lemurů.</description></item><item><title>Ranní karambol na tahu I/13: Auto skončilo mimo silnici, příčinu vyšetřují policisté</title><link>https://liberecka.drbna.cz/doprava/905294-ranni-karambol-na-tahu-i-13-auto-skoncilo-mimo-silnici-pricinu-vysetruji-policiste.html</link><guid isPermaLink="true">https://liberecka.drbna.cz/doprava/905294-ranni-karambol-na-tahu-i-13-auto-skoncilo-mimo-silnici-pricinu-vysetruji-policiste.html</guid><pubDate>Mon, 09 Nov 2026 10:56:00 +0100</pubDate><dc:creator>Martina Petrášková</dc:creator><category>Doprava</category><description>Mezi Rynolticemi a Bílým Kostelem nad Nisou skončilo ráno auto mimo vozovku, až za ochranným plotem proti zvěři. Zraněnou řidičku odvezla záchranka do nemocnice. Na místě zasahovaly složky IZS, policie řídí dopravu a apeluje na opatrnost řidičů, provoz v úseku je sveden do jednoho pruhu.</description></item><item><title>Po oblačném týdnu s deštěm se slunce vrátí až o víkendu</title><link>https://liberecka.drbna.cz/spolecnost/905270-po-oblacnem-tydnu-s-destem-se-slunce-vrati-az-o-vikendu.html</link><guid isPermaLink="true">https://liberecka.drbna.cz/spolecnost/905270-po-oblacnem-tydnu-s-destem-se-slunce-vrati-az-o-vikendu.html</guid><pubDate>Mon, 09 Nov 2026 08:52:00 +0100</pubDate><dc:creator>ČTK</dc:creator><category>Společnost</category><description>Do víkendu bude v Česku převážně oblačno nebo zataženo s deštěm a teplotami do deseti stupňů Celsia, do středy může v noci mrznout. Sněžit včetně středečního svátku svatého Martina může jen na horách, Na víkend se vrátí slunce a mrazivá rána.</description></item><item><title>V Liberci bude k Týdnu svobody sedm akcí, zapojí se divadla, muzeum i galerie</title><link>https://liberecka.drbna.cz/spolecnost/905240-v-liberci-bude-k-tydnu-svobody-sedm-akci-zapoji-se-divadla-muzeum-i.html</link><guid isPermaLink="true">https://liberecka.drbna.cz/spolecnost/905240-v-liberci-bude-k-tydnu-svobody-sedm-akci-zapoji-se-divadla-muzeum-i.html</guid><pubDate>Mon, 09 Nov 2026 06:54:00 +0100</pubDate><dc:creator>ČTK</dc:creator><category>Společnost</category><description>V Liberci se budou k Týdnu svobody konat divadelní představení, debaty i projekce. Do celostátní akce se od 11. do 17. listopadu zapojí obě městská divadla i krajské Severočeské muzeum a galerie Lázně. Za organizátory z iniciativy "Díky, že můžem" o tom informovala Julie Podlaha Zákostelecká.</description></item><item><title>Nové meteostanice i kamery. Jablonec modernizuje varovný a informační systém</title><link>https://liberecka.drbna.cz/spolecnost/905084-nove-meteostanice-i-kamery-jablonec-modernizuje-varovny-a-informacni-system.html</link><guid isPermaLink="true">https://liberecka.drbna.cz/spolecnost/905084-nove-meteostanice-i-kamery-jablonec-modernizuje-varovny-a-informacni-system.html</guid><pubDate>Sun, 08 Nov 2026 19:58:00 +0100</pubDate><dc:creator>Luboš Vrabec</dc:creator><category>Společnost</category><description>Do konce příštího roku by měl mít Jablonec zmodernizovaný varovný a informační systém. Celkové náklady jsou necelých 19 milionů korun a město pak bude moci rychleji reagovat na krizové situace.</description></item><item><title>Jablonečtí fotbalisté v lize remizovali doma 0:0 s Mladou Boleslaví</title><link>https://liberecka.drbna.cz/fotbal/905247-jablonecti-fotbaliste-v-lize-remizovali-doma-0-0-s-mladou-boleslavi.html</link><guid isPermaLink="true">https://liberecka.drbna.cz/fotbal/905247-jablonecti-fotbaliste-v-lize-remizovali-doma-0-0-s-mladou-boleslavi.html</guid><pubDate>Sun, 08 Nov 2026 17:21:27 +0100</pubDate><dc:creator>ČTK</dc:creator><category>Fotbal</category><description>Fotbalisté Jablonce ve 14. kole první ligy remizovali doma 0:0 s Mladou Boleslaví. Severočeši jsou po posledním zápase před reprezentační pauzou sedmí, Středočechům patří v neúplné tabulce třetí příčka.</description></item></channel></rss>

    <item>
      <title>Aktualizovaný přehled slev na Black Friday 2026. Kde a co se vyplatí nakoupit?</title>
      <link>https://www.zive.cz/clanky/black-friday-2026/sc-3-a-244154/default.aspx</link>
      <guid isPermaLink="false">244154-zive.cz</guid>
      <description>Až do konce listopadu zde najdete nejzajímavější zlevněné produkty. • Očekávejte tipy na chytrou elektroniku, aplikace, služby nebo kancelářskou výbavu. • Článek budeme několikrát denně doplňovat a také sledovat, jestli slevy stále platí.</description>
      <pubDate>Mon, 9 Nov 2026 07:45:00 GMT</pubDate>
      <dc:creator>Hlídač slev</dc:creator>
    </item>
    <item>
      <title>Deset let natahovali telefony do výšky. Teď výrobci zjistili, že se na nich vlastně nedá psát</title>
      <link>https://mobilmania.zive.cz/clanky/deset-let-jsme-natahovali-telefony-do-vysky-ted-vyrobci-zjistili-ze-se-na-nich-vlastne-neda-psat/sc-3-a-1365656/default.aspx</link>
      <guid isPermaLink="false">244340-zive.cz</guid>
      <description>Výrobci opouštějí úzké nudle a soustředí se na telefony s poměrem zhruba 3:2 • Širší displej má konečně dostatek místa pro psaní na klávesnici oběma palci • V Asii se zrodil nový trend. Kdy dorazí i do Evropy?</description>
      <pubDate>Mon, 9 Nov 2026 12:45:00 GMT</pubDate>
      <dc:creator>Martin Chroust</dc:creator>
    </item>
    <item>
      <title>Recenze filmu Povstání za svobodu: Revoluce bez příkras. Špinavá středověká řež má nepříjemně aktuální přesah</title>
      <link>https://avmania.zive.cz/recenze-filmu-povstani-za-svobodu-revoluce-bez-prikras-spinava-stredoveka-rez-ma-neprijemne-aktualni-presah</link>
      <guid isPermaLink="false">244336-zive.cz</guid>
      <description>Historické drama Povstání za svobodu (The Uprising) vstoupilo tento týden do kin a nabízí to, na co se fanoušek Paula Greengrasse těší – freneticky vyprávěný film zasazený do drsného středověku. Snímek to dodržuje, zároveň dává divákovi opak toho, co by od podobného snímku mohl čekat. A je to dobře.</description>
      <pubDate>Mon, 9 Nov 2026 16:45:00 GMT</pubDate>
      <dc:creator>Filip Šula</dc:creator>
    </item>
    <item>
      <title>Dotykový MacBook Pro si osahali světoví recenzenti. A většinou se vrátili ke klávesnici a trackpadu</title>
      <link>https://www.zive.cz/clanky/dotykovy-macbook-pro-si-osahali-svetovi-recenzenti-avetsinou-se-vratili-ke-klavesnici-a-trackpadu/sc-3-a-244338/default.aspx</link>
      <guid isPermaLink="false">244338-zive.cz</guid>
      <description>Apple poprvé vybavil MacBook Pro dotykovým displejem a vsadil na jasný OLED. • Recenzenti chválí obrazovou kvalitu, ale samotný dotyk příliš neoslnil. • Dotykové ovládání trpí stejnými problémy jako u notebooků s Windows.</description>
      <pubDate>Mon, 9 Nov 2026 15:45:00 GMT</pubDate>
      <dc:creator>Lukáš Václavík</dc:creator>
    </item>
    <item>
      <title>Recenze hry Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4. Akční blockbuster se zase staví na nohy</title>
      <link>https://doupe.zive.cz/call-of-duty-modern-warfare-4-recenze-ps5</link>
      <guid isPermaLink="false">244347-zive.cz</guid>
      <description>Po rozporuplném Modern Warfare 3 stálo Infinity Ward před nelehkým úkolem. Fanoušci chtěli návrat ke kořenům, silnou kampaň a multiplayer, který nebude působit jako recyklace předchozích ročníků. Modern Warfare 4 dokazuje, že série ještě neřekla poslední slovo. </description>
      <pubDate>Mon, 9 Nov 2026 14:15:00 GMT</pubDate>
      <dc:creator>Michal Polok</dc:creator>
    </item>
    <item>
      <title>Levné nákupy z Číny se znovu prodraží. Ke každé položce si teď přičtěte až 5 eur</title>
      <link>https://www.zive.cz/clanky/levne-nakupy-z-ciny-se-znovu-prodrazi-ke-kazde-polozce-si-ted-prictete-az-5-eur/sc-3-a-244341/default.aspx</link>
      <guid isPermaLink="false">244341-zive.cz</guid>
      <description>Evropská unie zpřísnila pravidla pro levné zásilky ze zahraničních internetových obchodů. Nové poplatky do jejího rozpočtu přinesou miliardy eur ročně.</description>
      <pubDate>Mon, 9 Nov 2026 13:45:00 GMT</pubDate>
      <dc:creator>Filip Maxa, Živé.sk</dc:creator>
    </item>
    </channel></rss>

Akce, která pokud vím, tu dosud neměla obdoby. Celá hala plná několika řad regálů a na nich kytky, spousty kytek. Mnohdy takových, jaké jste ještě nejspíš ani neviděli… A davy, odnášející si mnohdy nejednu plnou tašku. Neuvěřitelný výběr. Plus nějaké doplňky.

Pro mne zjištění, že jsem uvázl v minulosti a jsem mimo nejen v náhledu na ceny v restauracích, ale zaspal jsem i cenový vývoj u pokojovek. Vlastně hrůza, jak velké jmění mi za pár let doma různě uschlo…
